entries.name: Abjad-Kids: An Arabic Speech Classification Dataset for Primary Education
entries.notes: However, children speech research remains limited due to the lack of publicly available datasets.

entries.name: ADAB: Arabic Dataset for Automated Politeness Benchmarking -- A Large-Scale Resource for Computational Sociopragmatics
entries.notes: We introduce ADAB (Arabic Politeness Dataset), a new annotated Arabic dataset collected from four online platforms, including social media, e-commerce.

entries.name: AHA-Memes: A Fine-Grained Multimodal Benchmark for Understanding Hate in Arabic Memes
entries.notes: We introduce AHA-Memes (Arabic HAteful Memes), which is, to our knowledge, the first large-scale Arabic hateful meme benchmark with fine-grained.

entries.name: Alexandria: A Multi-Domain Dialectal Arabic Machine Translation Dataset for Culturally Inclusive and Linguistically Diverse LLMs
entries.notes: We introduce Alexandria, a large-scale, community-driven, human-translated dataset designed to bridge this gap.

entries.name: AlexandriaX 2026: The First Shared Task on Dialectal Arabic Machine Translation
entries.notes: We present the AlexandriaX 2026 Shared Task on Dialectal Arabic MT, which addresses these challenges through three complementary subtasks.

entries.name: Almieyar-Oryx-BloomBench: A Bilingual Multimodal Benchmark for Cognitively Informed Evaluation of Vision-Language Models
entries.notes: We introduce BloomBench, part of the Almieyar benchmarking series, the first cognitively human-grounded, bilingual.

entries.name: Almieyar: A Culturally Grounded Benchmark for Multi-Dialect Arabic Speech Recognition
entries.notes: We introduce ALMIEYAR, a culturally grounded ASR benchmark covering 17 Arabic dialects across six families.

entries.name: An End-to-End Hybrid Framework for Rumour Detection in Low-Resources Algerian Dialect
entries.notes: This paper presents an end-to-end rumour detection hybrid framework for Algerian dialect social media content.

entries.name: ArabDiscrim: A Decade-Long Arabic Facebook Corpus on Racism and Discrimination
entries.notes: We present ArabDiscrim, a decade-long lexical resource and corpus of 293K public Arabic Facebook posts (2014--2024) discussing racism and discrimination.

entries.name: Arabic Prompts with English Tools: A Benchmark
entries.notes: Large Language Models (LLMs) are now integral to numerous industries, increasingly serving as the core reasoning engine for autonomous agents.

entries.name: ArabicDialectHub: A Cross-Dialectal Arabic Learning Resource and Platform
entries.notes: We present ArabicDialectHub, a cross-dialectal Arabic learning resource comprising 552 phrases across six varieties.

entries.name: ArabicDialectSafety: A Dialect-Aware Benchmark for Arabic Content Safety Classification
entries.notes: ArabicDialectSafety: 25,071 human-curated safety prompts across MSA and four dialect groups, with seven harm categories and a dual-task evaluation.

entries.name: AraDetox: A Multi-Dialect Arabic Detoxification Dataset
entries.notes: We introduce AraDetox, a multi-dialect Arabic detoxification dataset comprising 10,500 harmful social-media posts and 84,000 detoxified rewrites.

entries.name: ARAFA: An LLM-Generated Arabic Fact-Checking Dataset
entries.notes: We introduce Arafa, a new large-scale dataset for fact-checking in Modern Standard Arabic, constructed through an automated framework.

entries.name: AraGenre 2026: A Hierarchical Definition-Guided Arabic Genre Classification Shared Task
entries.notes: AraGenre is a shared task on hierarchical, definition-guided Arabic genre classification, motivated by the limited availability of annotated data in Arabic.

entries.name: AraHopeCorpus: Annotation Guidelines and Dataset for Hope Speech in Arabic Social Media Crisis Discourse
entries.notes: This paper introduces AraHopeCorpus, the first annotated dataset of Arabic hope speech collected from ten thousand YouTube comments related to the war.

entries.name: AraMS-28k: The Largest Publicly Released Line-Level Dataset of Historical Arabic Manuscripts with Margin and Insertion-Anchor Annotations
entries.notes: We introduce AraMS-28k, the largest publicly released line-level dataset of genuine historical Arabic manuscripts, comprising 14 books, 3,043 pages.

entries.name: ARCADE: A City-Scale Corpus for Fine-Grained Arabic Dialect Tagging
entries.notes: We present ARCADE (Arabic Radio Corpus for Audio Dialect Evaluation), the first Arabic speech dataset designed explicitly with city-level dialect granularity.

entries.name: Are Arabic Benchmarks Reliable? QIMMA's Quality-First Approach to LLM Evaluation
entries.notes: We present QIMMA, a quality-assured Arabic LLM leaderboard that places systematic benchmark validation at its core.

entries.name: ArPoMeme: An Annotated Arabic Multimodal Dataset for Political Ideology and Polarization
entries.notes: This paper presents ArPoMeme, a large-scale dataset of approximately 7,300 Arabic political memes categorized by ideological orientation.

entries.name: Audience Engagement with Arabic Women's Social Empowerment and Wellbeing: A Decadal Corpus
entries.notes: This paper presents the Arabic Women and Society Corpus, a ten year collection of 252,487 public Arabic Facebook posts related to women's empowerment.

entries.name: BabelJudge: Measuring LLM-as-a-Judge Reliability Across Languages and Agent Trajectories
entries.notes: We introduce BabelJudge, an open-source benchmark and reliability audit framework that measures all four failure modes.

entries.name: Benchmarking Arabic--Russian Machine Translation: A Comparison of Fine-tuned NMT and Few-shot LLMs under Rich Morphology and Low Lexical Overlap
entries.notes: Arabic-Russian machine translation (MT) remains under-explored due to the rich morphology of Arabic and low lexical overlap between the two languages.

entries.name: Benchmarking Commercial ASR Systems on Code-Switching Speech: Arabic, Persian, and German
entries.notes: We present a benchmark evaluating five commercial ASR providers across four language pairs: Egyptian Arabic--English, Saudi Arabic.

entries.name: Benchmarking Frontier LLMs on Arabic Cultural and Sociolinguistic Knowledge: A Cross-Evaluation Framework with Human SME Ground Truth
entries.notes: The cost of human expert evaluation is a principal bottleneck to deploying language models in specialized, high-stakes domains.

entries.name: Beyond Fluency: A Rubric-Based Benchmark for Evaluating Saudi Dialect and Cultural Competence in Large Language Models
entries.notes: We present a rubric-based benchmark for the Saudi dialect, comprising 31 expert-authored prompts spanning idiomatic, pragmatic, lexical.

entries.name: Bolbosh: Script-Aware Flow Matching for Kashmiri Text-to-Speech
entries.notes: In this work, we present the first dedicated open-source neural TTS system designed for Kashmiri.

entries.name: Bridging Scientific Heritage: An Arabic--Russian Parallel Corpus and LLM Benchmark for Sustainable Knowledge Transfer
entries.notes: We present a benchmark for Arabic--Russian scientific translation.

entries.name: Bulbul: A Dataset for Dialectal Arabic Speech Recognition
entries.notes: We present BULBUL, a multi-dialect Arabic ASR dataset collected from 275 speakers in 11 Arab countries.

entries.name: CANDLE: CTC-based Arabic Noisy-character Deduplication using a Lightweight Encoder
entries.notes: We present CANDLE, a lightweight system for character-level Arabic noise deduplication that addresses this challenge without relying on handcrafted rules.

entries.name: CARDAMOM: A Micro-Dialectal Arabic Speech Dataset for ASR
entries.notes: Cardamom: about 40 hours of transcribed YouTube speech across 21 micro-dialects for fine-grained Arabic ASR evaluation.

entries.name: Cohesion-6K: An Arabic Dataset for Analyzing Social Cohesion and Conflict in Online Discourse
entries.notes: Cohesion-6K: 6,000 Arabic Facebook posts on the Israeli occupation of Palestine, labelled on a conflict-to-cohesion discourse scale.

entries.name: Cross-Lingual Learning within Arabic Script for Low-Resource HTR
entries.notes: Handwritten Text Recognition (HTR) with limited labeled data remains a challenging problem, particularly for Arabic-script languages.

entries.name: CrossHallu: Do Hallucination Signals Generalize Across Languages and Domains in Large Language Model's Internals?
entries.notes: We present CrossHallu, the first study to evaluate the cross-lingual and cross-domain generalization of hallucination detection.

entries.name: Cultural Benchmarking of LLMs in Standard and Dialectal Arabic Dialogues
entries.notes: We introduce ArabCulture-Dialogue, a culturally grounded conversational dataset covering 13 Arabic-speaking countries.

entries.name: Curriculum Learning and Pseudo-Labeling Improve the Generalization of Multi-Label Arabic Dialect Identification Models
entries.notes: We construct a multi-label dataset by generating automatic multi-label annotations using GPT-4o and binary dialect acceptability classifiers.

entries.name: CV-18 NER: Augmented Common Voice for Named Entity Recognition from Arabic Speech
entries.notes: We introduce CV-18 NER, the first publicly available dataset for NER from Arabic speech, created by augmenting the Arabic Common Voice 18 corpus.

entries.name: Do LLMs Fabricate Legal Citations? A Bilingual Benchmark on Saudi Data Protection Law and the GDPR
entries.notes: We introduce a bilingual benchmark of 120 questions probing whether freely accessible LLMs fabricate article citations for two data-protection instruments.

entries.name: E-CONAN (Entailment, CONtradition And Neutral) Benchmarks: Arabic Textual Entailment and Natural Inference Datasets
entries.notes: This paper introduces E-CONAN benchmarks that are composed of sentences pairs from various sources: (1) automatically-translated pairs.

entries.name: E-CONAN (Entailment, CONtradition And Neutral) Diagnostics Dataset Investigating Linguistic Phenomena in Arabic Natural Language Understanding
entries.notes: To overcome this gap, we propose an initial hierarchy for Cross-Lingual NLU error analysis.

entries.name: EDRAC: Benchmarking Arabic Dialect Reading Comprehension
entries.notes: We introduce EDRAC, the first large-scale benchmark for dialectal Arabic machine reading comprehension (MRC) and generative QA, covering five major dialects.

entries.name: Efficient Multilingual Neural Machine Translation via Corpus-Driven Vocabulary Pruning: An English-Arabic Case Study
entries.notes: We propose in this paper a general optimization framework that combines a vocabulary pruning method with a targeted fine-tuning protocol for MNMT models.

entries.name: Fanar-Sadiq: A Multi-Agent Architecture for Grounded Islamic QA
entries.notes: To address these challenges, we present Fanar-Sadiq, a bilingual Arabic-English Islamic QA system built on a multi-agent, tool-augmented architecture.

entries.name: Grounding Arabic LLMs in the Doha Historical Dictionary: Retrieval-Augmented Understanding of Quran and Hadith
entries.notes: RAG framework grounded in the Doha Historical Dictionary of Arabic that lifts Fanar and ALLaM above 85% on Quran and Hadith questions.

entries.name: Habibi: Laying the Open-Source Foundation of Unified-Dialectal Arabic Speech Synthesis
entries.notes: We present Habibi, a unified-dialectal Arabic TTS framework that addresses all three.

entries.name: HalluTruthQA-4K: A Fine-Grained Corpus and Annotation Process for Arabic Hallucination Detection and Truth Verification
entries.notes: We present HalluTruthQA-4K, an expanded version of the HalluTruthQA resource containing 4,000 expert-curated Arabic question-answering instances.

entries.name: HalluTruthQA: A Fine-Grained Benchmark for Hallucination Detection, Localization, and Explanation in Arabic Question Answering
entries.notes: We introduce HalluTruthQA, a fine-grained benchmark for hallucination evaluation in Arabic question answering.

entries.name: Halluverse-M^3: A multitask multilingual benchmark for hallucination in LLMs
